title: Applying DREAD Risk Scoring to AI Agent Monitoring Gaps

original_idea.body:
# Applying DREAD Risk Scoring to AI Agent Monitoring Gaps

**Problem:** DREAD (Damage, Reproducibility, Exploitability, Affected Users, Discoverability) is a classic risk scoring framework for vulnerabilities. It has not been applied to AI agent monitoring gaps.

**Direction:** Enumerate monitoring gaps from the LW threat matrix and METR red-team findings. Score each gap using DREAD. Produce a prioritized list of monitoring improvements ranked by DREAD score. Validate the ranking with expert annotation.

**Why it matters:** Risk prioritization is essential for resource-constrained monitoring development. DREAD provides a structured, reproducible method for this prioritization.

**Relevant context:** DREAD risk scoring (Microsoft); LW 2026 threat matrix; METR monitoring gaps.
